ns2:section.sectionText: Contemp Social and Env Problems, 3 hours. Geographic perspectives on contemporary national and international problems. Topics vary each term and include such themes as environmental quality, food production, urban problems, and particular social and political conflicts. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionDegreeAttributes: Discovery, and UIUC Social Sciences course.
